auth_details: OAuth2 authorization code flow for authenticated requests; many public GraphQL queries work without auth. Register an app at anilist.co/settings/developer. Pass access token as Authorization: Bearer {token}.
free_tier_limits: Free to use; no paid plans. Subject to rate limits (90 req/min).
rate_limits: 90 requests per minute (documented). Rate limit headers returned on responses.
example_request: curl -X POST https://graphql.anilist.co -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d '{"query":"query ($id: Int) { Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) { id title { romaji english native } episodes status } }","variables":{"id":15125}}'
description: AniList provides a public GraphQL API for anime and manga metadata, user lists, recommendations, and social activity. Developers query a single GraphQL endpoint for titles, characters, studios, and authenticated user data. Authentication uses OAuth2 for write and private user operations; many read queries work without a token.
resolution_notes: Disputed field rate_limits: auditor claim of temporary 30 req/min degradation could not be verified against live official docs at time of this write; official docs state 90 req/min. Re-check live AniList API/status pages before accepting degradation note.
